concern: She wants to end a hurtful on-and-off relationship with a man going through a difficult divorce but feels unable to let go.
first_advice: "letting go" is not really a thing... It's more of a process
acknowledged_before_advice: "Boy, ending relationships is tough, isn't it? Sometimes it's tough even when we are 100% sure that it is the right thing to do!" This normalizes and validates how hard it is to let go.
